newsitem.title: USA: Calif. unemployment rate drops to 6.8 pct - state.
newsitem.headline: Calif. unemployment rate drops to 6.8 pct - state.

text.p: California's unemployment rate dropped to 6.8 percent in December from a revised 7.0 percent in November, the state said on Friday.
The 6.8 percent rate was down from 7.8 percent in December 1995 and was the lowest in California since November 1990, the state Employment Development Department reported.
Construction, manufacturing, transportation and public utilities, retail and wholesale trade, and services continued to post job gains, it said.
"California's solid economic recovery is continuing," Gov. Pete Wilson said in a statement.
He added that the state was projected to gain about 330,000 jobs in 1997.
